_doc: What each account, debt and income type has (S-266). A feature is a yes, no or not sure question; yes opens its fields. tier core is screen one: it moves a headline number by more than APP_MATERIALITY, or the client knows it on the spot; it shows in the Session. tier extra is screen two: My numbers, in the More drawer. supplier: client (the client knows it), coach (the coach can look it up), guess (a house default or a guess, always shown as a guess). added: not on the owner's starting list. Read by engine/features.js.
